2026-10-22 release review: The portable discovery, provider sync, Codex refresh, method references, agent policies and synthetic checks are reviewed. scripts/usage_event.py remains excluded because it loads a separately configured private recorder. Optional public hooks use --portable and do not load usage counters.

Use the established first-party code/noncode defaults, reviewed source-inventory hashes, public commit lineage, current canonical bytes and documented recipient projections. Preserve all upstream/prior grants and private exclusions.

Project structure and tool routing conditionally use Prompt Playbook problem framing for unclear problems or methods. CLI routing also explains how to transfer a strong component and separate implementation and review roles without generalizing one result into a provider ranking. Earlier pending release history and all existing reviewed_additions remain intact.

Validation: 2026-10-20 efficient implementation integration: Changed skill frontmatter and relative links pass; installed bytes verified. Supplied-context behavioral trials cover vague prompts, exact edits, missing real business facts, injection, report-only work and task changes.

2026-10-20 portable workflow and review evidence: Five-package clean Claude runtime registered all 67 custom skills; successful router/Humanizer reads observed. Generic gate passed 22 evidence tests and self-test, plus explicit project-local mark/verify/stale checks. Native Codex refresh and exact parity verified.

2026-10-20 production specialist follow-through: Eleven work-start tests passed. All six router relative links and three specialist entrypoints resolve. Native Codex reinstall and exact parity passed for all three changed files. Final router wording was reviewed with natural-prose-editor and recorded in project-local evidence. Fresh native Opus5.5 High pair completed once per arm under equal1200-second caps. Enabled loaded complete Development, UX, Humanizer, router and prompt-refinement bodies before its first write, and recorded a review matching the final file; private tracking mirrored that genuine event afterward. All four submission hooks succeeded. Rendered audit separately found a phone overflow regression, so this verifies workflow delivery rather than a universal design-quality gain. No public publication started.

2026-10-21 API Anything: Eight wrapper boundary tests pass. Pinned build and real Hacker News HTTP read pass. Full source preserved; protocol and provider checks are recorded separately.
API Anything final checks: 10 wrapper tests, upstream type checking, 43 upstream tests and CLI/MCP Hacker News tier-1 reads passed; one returned item matched four source endpoint fields. Final review fixed readiness checking and pinned-command handoff.

2026-10-22 release review: Work Management package tests passed with one expected external-helper skip; package catalog validation passed. Scoped pending review will be refreshed. No version bump or publication.

35 package validations, 35 development archive integrity/legal packaging checks and 239 publisher tests pass. Eight actual standalone Stitch bundles remain byte-identical to their recorded released hashes, including source legal documents.

2026-10-27 release review: Read-only scoped local_sync.plan found 24 baseline-relative paths with no conflicts; eight differ in current canonical/public content and 16 already match on both sides. All eight current content diffs were inspected. Existing reviewed_additions and prior reconciliation history were preserved. This review did not run provider inference, UI trials or a fresh full package suite.
